description: The Cubicle plans (price per 30 days, what each includes) and exactly how to pay on Robinhood Chain in USDG: the treasury, the token, and — when the subscription vault is live — the two wallet transactions (approve, subscribe) that renew automatically every 30 days. Nothing here moves money: the trader signs in their own wallet.

plan.description: a plan id (pro-50 or premium-99) to prepare the payment steps for

wallet.description: the 0x address of the wallet that will pay — needed for the renewing subscription, which is authorized for that wallet only

name: plans
